    if not secret:\r
        return 503, {"error": "not configured"}\r
    body = params.get("body")\r
    signature = params.get("signature")\r
    if not isinstance(body, str) or not isinstance(signature, str):\r
        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}\r

    if hmac.compare_digest(expected.encode("ascii"), signature.lower().encode("utf-8")):\r

assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": "x"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid request"})
assert handle_verify_webhook({"signature": "x"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid request"})

assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": "x", "signature": None}) == (400, {"error": "invalid request"})

assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": body, "signature": "nön-ascii"}) == (401, {"error": "bad signature"})
print("ALL OK")
EOF
